image_prompt: Peter the Great rendered in cyberpunk anime style. An imposing figure standing at an exaggerated towering height, with broad, muscular shoulders and a commanding physique that dominates the frame. His face is sharp and angular with intense, penetrating eyes conveying ruthless intelligence and calculated ambition. He has long, dark hair with cybernetic streaks of neon blue and silver running through it, styled in a manner evoking 17th-century Russian nobility fused with futuristic elements. His skin bears subtle technological implants along the jawline and temples, glowing faintly with geometric patterns. He wears an ornate military coat rendered with sleek, armor-like plating in deep blacks and metallic grays, adorned with holographic insignia and circuit-board embroidery. Beneath the coat, glimpses of advanced bodysuit technology visible at the collar and wrists. His expression is stern and uncompromising, mouth set in grim determination. He exudes an air of austere power tempered by cold intellectual precision, the fusion of imperial ambition with cybernetic enhancement. Every detail suggests a figure of historical weight reimagined through a futuristic technological lens.
